role.zh: AI Evaluation · Red Teaming · Agent Reliability
role.en: AI Evaluation · Red Teaming · Agent Reliability

claim.zh: 模型和 Agent 会出问题。
更麻烦的是，用来评估它们的那套标准本身也可能不可靠。
claim.en: The harder problem is that the measurement used to judge them can fail too.

intro.zh: 我研究并构建可靠的 AI evaluation systems：从 Web / Computer-Use Agent、red teaming 和 judge calibration，到 post-training evaluation、benchmark provenance 与可复现实验基础设施。核心问题一直是同一个：一个分数或失败到底意味着什么，产生它的 measurement chain 能不能信。
intro.en: I study and build reliable AI evaluation systems across Web / Computer-Use agents, red teaming, judge calibration, post-training evaluation, benchmark provenance and reproducible research infrastructure. The recurring question is simple: what does a score or failure actually mean, and can the measurement chain that produced it be trusted?

lead.zh: 把 evaluation 当作系统，而不是一个分数：从 attack generation、target execution 和 grader audit，一直做到后期的可执行审计 pipeline 与 live delivery。
lead.en: Treated evaluation as a system rather than a score: from attack generation, target execution and grader auditing through to an executable audit pipeline and live delivery.

points.zh: 独立 owner 端到端 red-team / evaluation measurement line，并把 target behavior、provider-side filtering 与 grader outcome 从一个模糊的二元结果里拆开。
points.en: Owned an end-to-end red-team/evaluation measurement line and separated target behavior, provider-side filtering and grader outcomes instead of collapsing them into one ambiguous binary result.

points.zh: 用独立 labels 审计 judge / grader 的 FP/FN 与 failure modes，再把测量逻辑接入实际平台。
points.en: Audited judge/grader FP/FN and failure modes against independent labels, then integrated the measurement logic into the working platform.

points.zh: 后期构建 NYC Local Law 144 审计 pipeline：把规则转成确定性的 Python decision logic、evidence/logging 与可复核报告，并在真实数据上验证、完成最终 live demo。
points.en: Later built an NYC Local Law 144 audit pipeline: deterministic Python decision logic, evidence/logging and reviewable reporting, validated on real data and demonstrated live at the end of the internship.

role.zh: MSc Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Development · 2025–2026
role.en: MSc Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Development · 2025–2026

lead.zh: 研究 Web / Computer-Use Agent 的 representation choice 与 routing：先测有没有真实价值，再问这种价值能不能被可靠预测。
lead.en: Research on representation choice and routing for Web / Computer-Use agents: first measure whether value exists, then ask whether that value is actually learnable.

points.zh: 论文《Routing Is Least Learnable Where It Is Most Valuable》已被 EMNLP 2026 Workshop REALM 录用。
points.en: “Routing Is Least Learnable Where It Is Most Valuable” was accepted at the EMNLP 2026 Workshop REALM.

points.zh: 研究包含预注册、受控表征比较、task-level failure analysis、representation probes 与可恢复的异构算力实验系统。
points.en: The work combines preregistration, controlled representation comparisons, task-level failure analysis, representation probes and a recoverable heterogeneous-compute experiment system.

lead.zh: 自动化与机器学习背景；后续逐步把研究重心收敛到可靠 AI evaluation、agent systems 与实验方法。
lead.en: Background in automation and machine learning, later converging on reliable AI evaluation, agent systems and experimental methods.

title.zh: Web Agent 表征路由：价值最高的地方，反而最难学
title.en: Routing Is Least Learnable Where It Is Most Valuable

lead.zh: DOM、SoM、视觉等表征之间确实存在互补价值；但“事后知道哪个表征更值钱”并不意味着 router 能在执行前学会选对。研究把 representation value 与 routing learnability 拆开测量，并把这个负结果变成可解释的边界。
lead.en: DOM, SoM and vision do contain complementary value. But hindsight value does not imply that a router can predict the right representation before execution. The study separates representation value from routing learnability and turns that negative result into a measurable bound.

points.zh: 受控比较 DOM / SoM / vision 与 phantom representations，先预注册，再跑实验。
points.en: Controlled comparison of DOM / SoM / vision and phantom representations, preregistered before the main runs.

points.zh: 主结论是 routing value–learnability gap：value ≠ learnability。
points.en: Core result: a routing value–learnability gap — value does not imply learnability.

points.zh: 追 task-level failure 与 representation difference，并用 activation patching / linear probes 定位表征差异。
points.en: Tracks task-level failures and representation differences, with activation patching / linear probes for diagnosis.

points.zh: 大型可复现实验系统支持异构算力编排、自动恢复与 1K+ research tests。
points.en: Large reproducible research system with heterogeneous-compute orchestration, automatic recovery and 1K+ research tests.

cap.zh: 成本差异不是这项研究最难的部分。真正困难的是：什么时候该看什么，以及这个判断到底能不能被学出来。
cap.en: The hard part was not the small cost gap between representations. It was learning when to use which representation — and whether that decision is learnable at all.

pull.zh: 攻击跑出来了，不等于攻击真的成功了。
pull.en: An attack running is not the same as an attack succeeding.

lead.zh: 把 target、execution harness、provider behavior、judge 与独立 gold labels 放在同一条 measurement chain 上。系统不仅问“模型有没有被攻破”，也问“负责判定这件事的工具自己靠不靠谱”。
lead.en: Puts the target, execution harness, provider behavior, judge and independent gold labels on the same measurement chain. The system asks not only whether the target failed, but whether the evaluator itself is trustworthy.

points.zh: 166 个 plugin 映射到本地生成机制，其中 103 个通过端到端验证后启用。
points.en: 166 plugins mapped to local generation mechanisms; 103 enabled after end-to-end verification.

points.zh: 攻击按目标动态生成；zero-egress 路径可以把生成、攻击与判定留在本机。
points.en: Target-conditioned attack generation; a zero-egress path can keep generation, execution and judging local.

points.zh: 同一 probe 上曾发现 upstream refusal shortcut 漏掉 16 个 breach 中的 8 个。
points.en: Found an upstream refusal shortcut that missed 8 of 16 breaches on one probe.

featured.stack: JavaScript · Node · Postgres · TanStack Start · SST / Lambda

alt.zh: redteam-under-test cockpit：风险图、攻击面、成本与运行趋势
alt.en: redteam-under-test cockpit with risk, attack surface, cost and run trends

cap.zh: 同一套系统里看攻击面，也看自己的判官是否可信。
cap.en: The same system inspects the attack surface and the reliability of its own judge.

pull.zh: 一边诱导 Agent 越界，一边确保它真越界时留下可重放证据。
pull.en: Stress the agent into crossing a boundary, while making sure any real crossing leaves replayable evidence.

lead.zh: 攻击侧研究 replay / model-hop / 调用预算；防守侧把 tool-call trace analyzer 做成 read-only MCP，只分析轨迹，不替 Agent 执行真实动作。
lead.en: The attack side studies replay, model-hop and call budgets; the defensive side exposes a read-only MCP analyzer that inspects tool-call traces without executing real actions.

points.zh: 检测 trust-boundary crossing、敏感数据外传、destructive action、confused-deputy 与缺失授权。
points.en: Detects trust-boundary crossing, sensitive-data egress, destructive actions, confused-deputy behavior and missing authorization.

points.zh: 规则采用“降级不压制”：调用方自报已审批，也不能一句话把已发现的风险抹掉。
points.en: Uses a degrade-not-suppress rule: caller claims of approval cannot erase already-observed risk.

pull.zh: 模型涨了 20 分，先别急着说训练有效。
pull.en: A model gained twenty points. That still does not tell you why.

lead.zh: 把 protocol、answer-format SFT、显式思考与 RLVR 分开控制，追问分数变化究竟来自能力、协议还是 reward exploitation。
lead.en: Controls protocol, answer-format SFT, explicit reasoning and RLVR separately to attribute score changes to capability, protocol alignment or reward exploitation.

points.zh: 只切回正确 native chat protocol，部分大模型即可恢复约 +20–30 分。
points.en: Switching back to the correct native chat protocol alone recovered roughly +20–30 points for some larger base models.

points.zh: 4B answer-only SFT 没有显著净增益；paired McNemar 把“感觉涨了”变成可检验问题。
points.en: 4B answer-only SFT showed no significant net gain; paired McNemar turned an apparent improvement into a testable claim.

points.zh: GRPO/RLVR 出现明显 reward exploitation，任务准确率反而下降。
points.en: GRPO/RLVR exposed clear reward exploitation while task accuracy fell.

featured.stack: Python · PyTorch · Qwen3 · TRL · LoRA / SFT / GRPO

pull.zh: 我最不想做的，就是再造一个解释不清的“万能总分”。
pull.en: The last thing I wanted was another universal score with unclear semantics.

lead.zh: 不同来源、harness 与 benchmark 语义分开保存；缺失就是 N/A，agent-system 成绩不伪装成纯模型能力。上游 live boards 自动重抓并做 drift checks。
lead.en: Keeps source, harness and benchmark semantics distinct. Missing evidence stays N/A, agent-system results are not relabelled as pure model ability, and live upstream boards are re-read with automated drift checks.

points.zh: 每条 observation 保留来源、版本、日期、harness、reasoning effort 与 tool setting。
points.en: Each observation retains source, version, date, harness, reasoning effort and tool setting.

points.zh: 把 capability、agent systems、coding systems、human preference、speed 与 price 分开。
points.en: Separates capability, agent systems, coding systems, human preference, speed and price.

alt.en: AI Model Observatory ranking and comparison interface

cap.en: Live counts stay inside the live product; the portfolio no longer hand-copies volatile observation totals.

text.en: An agent control plane spanning ChatGPT Web, durable GitHub transport and a constrained runner: capable of acting while keeping hard capability boundaries.

text.en: A 60-minute, $2-LLM-budget, CPU-only autonomous ML agent focused on leaderboard stability and guaranteed-valid submissions rather than public-score chasing.

text.en: A LaTeX-aware academic rewrite pipeline where models propose diffs and deterministic invariant gates protect numbers, citations, equations and terms.

text.en: Turns first-person narration into a persistent topological map, treating graph topology as truth and geometry as a visual hypothesis.

text.en: An offline-first SwiftUI fitness system with SQLite as source of truth, HealthKit, deterministic scheduling and a transactional outbox.

title.zh: 我想继续做一件事：把模型和 Agent 的“看起来不错”，变成真正经得住检查的结果。
title.en: I want to keep turning “looks good” into results that survive inspection.

posterTitle.zh: 什么时候值得为更昂贵的感知付费？
posterTitle.en: When Is Expensive Perception Worth Paying For?

posterSubtitle.zh: 测试更丰富的 Web-Agent 表征什么时候真的有用，以及这种价值能不能被低成本预测。
posterSubtitle.en: Testing when richer web-agent representations help — and whether their value can be predicted cheaply.

people.en: Jiaming Wei · Supervisors: María Pérez-Ortiz · Zekun Wu

task.zh: 同一个编辑商品任务，两种表征从同一点出发。
task.en: The same listing-edit task, viewed through two representations from the same start.

note.zh: 两个结果在独立 rerun 中都复现。这里展示的是行为差异，不是宣称 text-only 普遍更强。
note.en: Both outcomes repeated on an independent rerun. This is evidence of behavioral difference, not a claim that text-only is universally stronger.

title.zh: 没有一种视图处处获胜

text.zh: DOM / SoM / vision 的优势依任务而变，单一表征不能覆盖所有成功集合。
text.en: DOM, SoM and vision win on different tasks; no single representation covers the full success set.

title.zh: 它们解决的是不同任务子集

text.zh: 成功集合有重叠，但并不重合；这是真实 routing headroom 的来源。
text.en: The success sets overlap but do not coincide — the source of real routing headroom.

text.zh: 视觉模式在这组分析里滚动约 4× 更多，表征变化会改变 agent 的行动动力学。
text.en: Vision scrolls roughly 4× more in this analysis; representation changes the agent's action dynamics.

text.zh: text-only 更偏早期 give-up；image-only 更偏 stalled progress。
text.en: Text-only skews toward early give-up; image-only toward stalled progress.

title.zh: 有 routing 价值，不等于 router 学得会
title.en: Routing value does not imply a learnable router

text.zh: learned routers 往往需要花更多成本才能买到成功，只有 hindsight oracle 稳定进入真正的 win region。
text.en: Learned routers tend to buy success by spending more; only the hindsight oracle reliably reaches the win region.

title.zh: 越有上行空间，监督信号反而越稀
title.en: More upside can mean less usable supervision

text.zh: 核心边界是 value–learnability gap：最值得动态选择的地方，往往正是标签最稀、最难提前预测的地方。
text.en: The core boundary is the value–learnability gap: where adaptive choice matters most, usable labels can be sparsest and prediction hardest.

disclosure.zh: 最终 poster/showcase 的研究结论可以公开；公司内部材料、客户数据和私有实现不在这个页面里。
disclosure.en: The research conclusions shown at the final poster/showcase are public-safe; private company material, client data and internal implementation are excluded.

profile.role: Research Engineer — Reliable Agent Evaluation & Adaptive Agentic Systems
claim: What evidence is reliable enough to support an adaptive agent decision?
I study that question across web agents, evaluator reliability, trajectories and post-training.
profile.intro: I study how to evaluate agentic systems when the evidence itself is unreliable: task outcomes vary across reruns, automatic judges make systematic errors, and final success labels can hide failures in trajectories, tools, providers or evaluation infrastructure.

researchDirection.label: RESEARCH DIRECTION · FALL 2027
researchDirection.title: Reliable Agent Evaluation for Adaptive Agentic Systems
researchDirection.question: What minimum evidence is required before an adaptive agent is justified in changing its behaviour or learning from feedback?
researchDirection.text: My current direction treats evaluator error and outcome instability as part of the decision problem itself: when should an agent acquire richer perception, switch models, call a verifier, retry, ask a human, spend more test-time compute or abstain?
researchDirection.next: perception · models · tools · memory · retries · verification · test-time compute

resume.eyebrow: PHD / RESEARCH CV · RELIABLE AGENT EVALUATION
resume.summary: I study how to evaluate agentic systems when the evidence itself is unreliable: task outcomes vary across reruns, automatic judges make systematic errors, and final success labels can hide failures in trajectories, tools, providers or evaluation infrastructure. My current research asks what evidence is reliable enough to support adaptive decisions about perception, models, tools, memory, retries and test-time computation.

closing.title: I want to make evaluation reliability part of the agent decision problem, not an afterthought.
closing.sub: Current Fall 2027 direction: reliable agent evaluation, evaluator-aware adaptation, trajectory-grounded supervision and resource-aware verification.
